verdict.rationale: Mem0 is a memory-layer service/platform that exposes itself as an MCP server so other agents can call its memory tools (docs-2, docs-18, docs-27, probe-3) — it is not itself an agent that consumes external tools via MCP. The story asks whether the product can plug in and use OTHER MCP servers' tools, which is a client-side agentic capability that doesn't fit Mem0's role as a memory backend/tool provider; no evidence suggests Mem0 acts as an MCP client.
